title: Version Check executor schema
description: Validates that version bumps have been correctly applied without making changes. Used by CI to verify that lefthook versioning ran successfully.

verbose.description: Enable verbose output for debugging. Shows additional details about validation.

skipIfVersionCommit.description: Skip validation if the current commit is a version/release commit.

repository.description: Repository resolution for changelog compare URLs. Options: 'disabled' (no URLs), 'inferred' (auto-detect from package.json or git remote), or an object with mode and options.

inferenceOrder.description: Order of inference sources when mode is 'inferred'. Default: ['package-json', 'git-remote']

baseUrl.description: Repository base URL (for explicit mode), e.g., 'https://github.com/owner/repo'

scopeFiltering.description: Scope filtering configuration for commit classification.

excludeScopes.description: Scopes to exclude even if files match.

infrastructure.description: Infrastructure path and scope tracking configuration.

paths.description: File paths to track as infrastructure.

maxCommitFallback.description: Upper bound on the commit window the flow analyzes for bumps and changelogs.
